text:
Lina (Sales): AcmeX asked for a POC next month. They require a small dedicated endpoint and a documented list of public egress IPs to give their security team. Any constraints?

Diego (Solutions Eng): two patterns: 1) allocate dedicated SNAT IPs for their Dedicated endpoint (we own the IPs, static for the window); 2) they run a forward proxy / NAT in their VPC and route through it (their IP is the only one to whitelist).

Tara (Net Eng): we can carve 1-3 /32 SNAT addresses for a short POC. Note: these SNATs are NAT mapping addresses so inbound won't hit our infra. We'll provide a CSV of per-connection SNAT mapping if they need logs.

Priya (Security): prefer ephemeral API keys scoped to a project and rotate them mid-POC. Also need a signed NDA for flow-log exports.

Lina (Sales): they prefer the least changes on their side, so static IPs sound better. They asked whether IP ranges could be expressed as /29 or only /32s.

Tara (Net Eng): we typically hand out /32s. If they need a CIDR, we can provide multiple contiguous /32s but not a customer-owned /29. Firewall example we send:```Allow TCP 443 from 52.24.101.77/32, 52.24.101.78/32```

Diego (Solutions Eng): ask them QPS and peak concurrency so we can confirm SNAT capacity. If traffic is bursty, we may recommend a short burst allowance or additional SNATs.

Ken (Finance): pricing note for the SOW: for a 3-week trial on a single small Dedicated pool we quote a one-time POC fee equal to 40% of monthly reserved pricing (pro-rated) or waive it if they sign within 30 days. We need to confirm exact SKU.

Lina (Sales): @CustomerNet can you confirm expected RPS and whether you want us to rotate IPs weekly or keep static for the POC? Also who is your firewall admin contact?

CustomerNet (external): prefer static list, peak ~80 RPS, not bursty. firewall contact is netops@acmex.com. no rotation please.

Priya (Security): for auditability we will provide flow-log export with columns: timestamp, source_ip, dest_ip, dest_port, snat_ip. That should satisfy their security team. We'll also create a short audit report at POC end.

Tara (Net Eng): operational note: allocating SNATs requires a 3-6 hour change window and a verification step. We'll need the exact start/end times for the POC.

Diego (Solutions Eng): integration tip for their infra team if they want to proxy: sample curl:```curl -x http://10.0.0.12:3128 -H "Authorization: Bearer POCPREFIX-abc123" https://api.redwood-inference/v1/chat```

Lina (Sales): should I include the finance language (40% prorate) in the quote or wait for SKU confirmation?

Ken (Finance): include it as a placeholder in the SOW and mark as TBD SKU. I'll review before sending.

infra-bot: created ticket https://tickets.internal/POC-4122 for SNAT allocation and flow-log export :white_check_mark:

Diego (Solutions Eng): once SNATs are allocated, we'll run a quick smoke test and share a test IP that they can curl to verify whitelist.

Priya (Security): also confirm retention window for logs with them (default 90 days, can shorten on request).

CustomerNet (external): 90 days is fine. Please send the static IP list and the exact POC time window.

Lina (Sales): next steps: I'll confirm start/end dates with AcmeX and update ticket POC-4122 with firewall contact and QPS. Thanks all.

Diego (Solutions Eng): I'll draft the short-run SOW + network appendix after finance confirms SKU.

Tara (Net Eng): when dates are set, I'll schedule the network change window.

Lina (Sales): closing loop for now, will post updates in ticket thread. :thumbsup:
